overview: White keeps a flexible, compact set-up with e3, Bd3, O-O and c4 or b3 depending on Black's reply. Black usually plays ...c5, ...b6 or ...d5 and the game often transposes to a Queen's Gambit, Colle or Semi-Tarrasch structure. A quiet system where White plays for a slight pull without early commitments.

white_ideas.idea: Develop with Bd3, O-O, c4 or c3, Nbd2 and aim at e4.
Choose between a Colle-style e4 break and a QGD-style c4 depending on Black's set-up.

black_ideas.idea: Play ...c5 and ...b6, Bb7 or ...d5 with a solid development.
Challenge e4 and the centre with timely ...c5 and ...d5 breaks.

typical_structures.structure: Queen's Gambit or Semi-Tarrasch type centre with White pawns on d4, e3, c4.

character.notes: Solid and flexible; transposes to quiet queen's-pawn structures with little early tactical content.

structure.notes: Centre in tension and flexible with transposition possibilities.

approach.notes: A set-up White can play against several Black defences.

level.notes: Little memory needed, though the transpositions need sense.

character.reason: Quiet development with few ways to lose quickly.

structure.reason: The centre is undecided and can transpose.

approach.reason: The e3/Bd3 set-up is playable against many defences.

level.reason: Plans are simple but the transpositions need care.

plans.reason: No single plan from the list stands out.
